CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Exhaust }` (Toxic.cs:15) == `exhausts = True`, and NOT Unplayable -- Toxic is a PLAYABLE status whose play exists only to exhaust it before end of turn, and the sim correctly leaves `is_playable` True. The same shape as card/slimed and card/spore_mind.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Status, CardRarity.Status, TargetType.None)` (Toxic.cs:21-24) == cost 1 / STATUS / STATUS / NONE. A REAL cost of 1, not the -1 sentinel, so the ascenders_bane cost finding does not apply.

CanonicalVars.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): (Task 24.) All 23 cards now store their printed C# var under a `_`-attribute (or, for 3 cards whose C# var is a live/computed value at display time -- guilty, normality, expect_a_fight -- a `magic_number` property override; wither similarly overrides `base_damage`) so `Card.base_damage`/`base_block`/`base_hp_loss`/`magic_number` report the C# value instead of the 0/None default. Two additive base.py changes: `_frail` added to `_MAGIC_ATTRS` (shame) and a new `base_gold` property (debt, spoils_map -- GoldVar had no base property at all). feel_no_pain's `_block` was renamed to `_power_amount` (fixing a WRONG value, not just a missing one -- `base_block` no longer misreports it as block-granting; matches Rage/Corruption/Stampede's DynamicVar('Power', ...) convention). Combat behavior / dealt numbers are byte-identical in every case -- a printed-number / observation-encoder fix only. 3 of the 23 (debt, spoils_map, rolling_boulder's secondary IncrementAmount) have NO obs-vector change despite the API fix (full_env.py has no base_gold read site; magic_number carries one number per card and _power_amount dominates rolling_boulder's scan) -- documented, not closed further. CHECKPOINT NOTE for training: encoded VALUES changed for the other 20 cards in feature slots f[17]/f[18] damage, f[20]/f[21] block, f[22] hp_loss, f[23] magic_number; obs LAYOUT unchanged. Pins: test/test_printed_vars.py. Re-confirmed current on this stale-sweep pass (2026-08-04): `self._damage = 5` (toxic.py:33) is a real `_damage` attribute now, so `Card.base_damage`/`magic_number` both surface it and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:700-744, moved from :455-489; magic_number read at line 736) now encodes the card correctly. The PROP SET is right: the sim passes no explicit props and `DamageCmd.deal` infers `DamageProps.CARD_UNPOWERED` (UNPOWERED | MOVE) from `is_unpowered = True` (cmds.py, toxic.py:27), so the 5 damage is not Strength-scaled and IS blockable on both sides -- identical to card/burn, card/decay and card/infection. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's and card/stampede's CanonicalVars entries (rule 3) -- all now faithful post-fix, formerly DORMANT-for-game-fidelity / LIVE-for-observation-encoder; CLOSED.

OnTurnEndInHand.rationale: `CreatureCmd.Damage(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Damage, this)` (Toxic.cs:28) -- passing the VAR so the props ride along -- == `DamageCmd.deal(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._damage, dealer=None, card=self)` with the inferred props. Explicit null dealer on both sides. At 5 damage this is the hardest-hitting end-of-turn status in the pool.

OnPlay.rationale: Toxic.cs declares no OnPlay, so playing it costs 1 and only exhausts the card. A reachable no-op on both sides.
